    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.rts_tat) AS rts_tat,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.date >= (CURRENT_DATE - '6 mons'::interval) THEN date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS f_ready_to_ship_at_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.f_at_pickup_from_date) AS f_at_pickup_from_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.f_agent_assigned_at_date) AS f_agent_assigned_at_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.delivered_date) AS delivered_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.cancelled_date) AS cancelled_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.picked_date) AS picked_date,
    date_trunc('minute'::text, mw.promised_time_to_deliver) AS promised_time_to_deliver,
    mw.awbnumber,
    o."Buyer NP" AS buyer_np,
    o."Seller NP" AS retail_snp,
        CASE
            WHEN o."Network order id" IS NULL THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END AS "Linked Orders",
    mw.rn_retail AS dedup,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.rn_order = 1 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS order_count,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Completed'::text AND mw.delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.delivered_date - mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS avg_del,
    round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.promised_time_to_deliver - mw.order_created_at) / 60::numeric, 0) AS del_tat_duration,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Completed'::text AND mw.delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN mw.delivered_date <= mw.promised_time_to_deliver THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS del_adherence,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Completed'::text AND mw.delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.promised_time_to_deliver IS NOT NULL AND mw.delivered_date > mw.promised_time_to_deliver THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.delivered_date - mw.promised_time_to_deliver)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS del_breach_diff,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date - mw.order_created_at)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rtsvscrt,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.picked_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(mw.f_at_pickup_from_date, mw.picked_date) - mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rtsvspck,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Completed'::text AND mw.delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.delivered_date - mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS delage,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text = 'Cancelled'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.cancelled_date - mw.order_created_at)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cancel_secs,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.order_status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['Completed'::character varying::text, 'Cancelled'::character varying::text]) THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - mw.order_created_at::timestamp with time zone) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS in_process_ageing,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.f_at_pickup_from_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.picked_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.picked_date - mw.f_at_pickup_from_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rider_waiting,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.f_agent_assigned_at_date IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.f_agent_assigned_at_date - mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rider_assigning,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.pickup_tat IS NOT NULL AND (mw.f_at_pickup_from_date IS NOT NULL OR mw.picked_date IS NOT NULL) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(mw.f_at_pickup_from_date, mw.picked_date) <= mw.pickup_tat THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS pick_up_breached,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.pickup_tat IS NOT NULL AND (mw.f_at_pickup_from_date IS NOT NULL OR mw.picked_date IS NOT NULL) THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(mw.f_at_pickup_from_date, mw.picked_date) - mw.pickup_tat)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS pick_up_tat_diff,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.rts_tat IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date <= mw.rts_tat THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS rts_breached,
        CASE
            WHEN mw.rts_tat IS NOT NULL AND mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM mw.f_ready_to_ship_at_date - mw.rts_tat)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rts_tat_diff
   FROM master_with_rownum mw
     LEFT JOIN analytics_insight.order_level o ON o."Network order id"::text = mw.retail_order_id::text;

                    WHEN COALESCE(snp.seller_np, 'Others'::text) = COALESCE(lsp."logistics NP name", 'Others'::text) THEN 'Intra NP'::text
                    ELSE 'Inter NP'::text
                END AS "Np type Logistics",
                CASE
                    WHEN (t1."Resolved"::text = ANY (ARRAY['Yes'::character varying::text, 'Forced Resolved'::character varying::text])) AND t1.r_action_ticket_resolved_date > t1.ticket_expected_resolution_time THEN 'Yes'::text
                    WHEN t1."Resolved"::text = 'No'::text AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= t1.ticket_expected_resolution_time THEN 'Yes'::text
                    ELSE 'No'::text
                END AS "Breached",
                CASE t1.ticket_status
                    WHEN 'CLOSED'::text THEN 'Closed'::text
                    WHEN 'OPEN'::text THEN 'Open'::text
                    WHEN 'REOPENED'::text THEN 'ReOpened'::text
                    WHEN 'WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER_UPDATE'::text THEN 'Pending with Customer'::text
                    WHEN 'WAITING_FOR_LOGISTIC_UPDATE'::text THEN 'Pending with Logistics NP'::text
                    WHEN 'WAITING_FOR_SELLER_NP_UPDATE'::text THEN 'Pending with Seller NP'::text
                    WHEN 'WAITING_FOR_SELLER_UPDATE'::text THEN 'Pending with Provider'::text
                    ELSE 'Undefined Status'::text
                END AS "Status",
                CASE
                    WHEN t1."Resolved"::text = 'Yes'::text THEN t1."min_diff(resolved)"::numeric / 60.0
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS "Resolved hour",
                CASE
                    WHEN t1."Resolved"::text = 'Yes'::text THEN t1."ticket count"::bigint
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END AS resolved_ticket,
                CASE
                    WHEN t1."Resolved"::text = 'No'::text THEN t1."ticket count"::bigint
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END AS unresolved_ticket,
                CASE
                    WHEN t1."Resolved"::text = 'Forced Resolved'::text THEN t1."ticket count"::bigint
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END AS forced_resolved_ticket,
                CASE
                    WHEN upper(COALESCE(t1.issue_sync_response, ''::text::character varying)::text) = 'ACK'::text THEN t1."ticket count"::bigint
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END AS ack_logistics,
                CASE
                    WHEN upper(COALESCE(t1.issue_sync_response, ''::text::character varying)::text) = 'NACK'::text THEN t1."ticket count"::bigint
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END AS nack_logistics,
                CASE
                    WHEN t1.on_issue_error_code IS NOT NULL AND t1.on_issue_error_code::text <> ''::text THEN t1."ticket count"::bigint
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END AS on_issue_error_logistics,
                CASE
                    WHEN t1.issue_sync_response::text = 'NACK'::text OR t1.on_issue_error_code IS NOT NULL AND t1.on_issue_error_code::text <> ''::text THEN t1."ticket count"::bigint
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END AS rejected_logistics,
            t1."ticket count" -
                CASE
                    WHEN t1.issue_sync_response::text = 'NACK'::text OR t1.on_issue_error_code IS NOT NULL AND t1.on_issue_error_code::text <> ''::text THEN t1."ticket count"::bigint
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END AS net_tickets_logistics,
                CASE
                    WHEN t1."Resolved"::text = 'Yes'::text AND t1."tat_diff(res)" <= 0::double precision THEN t1."ticket count"::bigint

        CASE
            WHEN order_status::text = 'Cancelled'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM cancelled_date - order_created_at)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS cancel_secs,
        CASE
            WHEN order_status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['Completed'::text, 'Cancelled'::text]) THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - order_created_at::timestamp with time zone) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS in_process_ageing,
        CASE
            WHEN f_at_pickup_from_date IS NOT NULL AND picked_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM picked_date - f_at_pickup_from_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rider_waiting,
        CASE
            WHEN f_agent_assigned_at_date IS NOT NULL AND f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM f_agent_assigned_at_date - f_ready_to_ship_at_date) / 60::numeric, 0)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rider_assigning,
        CASE
            WHEN pickup_tat IS NOT NULL AND (f_at_pickup_from_date IS NOT NULL OR picked_date IS NOT NULL) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(f_at_pickup_from_date, picked_date) <= pickup_tat THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS pick_up_breached,
        CASE
            WHEN pickup_tat IS NOT NULL AND (f_at_pickup_from_date IS NOT NULL OR picked_date IS NOT NULL) THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM COALESCE(f_at_pickup_from_date, picked_date) - pickup_tat)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS pick_up_tat_diff,
        CASE
            WHEN rts_tat IS NOT NULL AND f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN f_ready_to_ship_at_date <= rts_tat THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS rts_breached,
        CASE
            WHEN rts_tat IS NOT NULL AND f_ready_to_ship_at_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM f_ready_to_ship_at_date - rts_tat)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS rts_tat_diff
   FROM master_with_rownum mw;
